ELUCIDATION
ON
REGIONAL REGULATION OF WONOSOBO REGENCY
NUMBER 2 YEAR 2012
CONCERNING
SOCIAL PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION

The development targets in the field of social welfare regulated in this Regional Regulation are directed toward Women and Children. Especially programs for improving the quality of life and protection of women and children. This is aligned with the objectives and functions of a Regional Regulation to regulate certain matters in accordance with the conditions and needs of a region.

This Regional Regulation on Social Protection for Women and Children aims to provide a legal basis for efforts of Social Protection for Women and Children as well as to provide studies within the philosophical, sociological and juridical framework regarding the necessity of a Regional Regulation that becomes the legal foundation for handling social problems in Wonosobo Regency, particularly related to Women and Children.

Substantively, in the effort to overcome the problems of Women and Children in Wonosobo Regency, it is necessary to formulate a Regional Regulation concerning Social Protection for Women and Children which essentially constitutes an action that is rooted in or has a strong foundation, namely in good governance, and to be formulated with correct principles.

The regulation of the field of Social Protection for Women and Children must consider environmental aspects and social aspects, so that the social conditions of the community are controlled. The regulation of Social Protection for Women and Children through Regional Regulation can be viewed as a solution as well as a preventive effort against negative impacts that potentially harm the interests of the community.

The absence of a specific Regional Regulation governing Social Protection for Women and Children in Wonosobo Regency makes the urgency of this Regional Regulation indeed necessary as a legal umbrella for the creation of legal certainty in matters of Social Protection for Women and Children, which is an obligation of the Regional Government, specifically the Wonosobo Regional Government, to provide Social Protection for Women and Children of Wonosobo Regency.

ELUCIDATION
ON
REGIONAL REGULATION OF WONOSOBO REGENCY
NUMBER 2 YEAR 2012
CONCERNING
SOCIAL PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION

The development targets in the field of social welfare regulated in this Regional Regulation are directed toward Women and Children. Especially programs for improving the quality of life and protection of women and children. This is aligned with the objectives and functions of a Regional Regulation to regulate certain matters in accordance with the conditions and needs of a region.

This Regional Regulation on Social Protection for Women and Children aims to provide a legal basis for efforts of Social Protection for Women and Children as well as to provide studies within the philosophical, sociological and juridical framework regarding the necessity of a Regional Regulation that becomes the legal foundation for handling social problems in Wonosobo Regency, particularly related to Women and Children.

Substantively, in the effort to overcome the problems of Women and Children in Wonosobo Regency, it is necessary to formulate a Regional Regulation concerning Social Protection for Women and Children which essentially constitutes an action that is rooted in or has a strong foundation, namely in good governance, and to be formulated with correct principles.

The regulation of the field of Social Protection for Women and Children must consider environmental aspects and social aspects, so that the social conditions of the community are controlled. The regulation of Social Protection for Women and Children through Regional Regulation can be viewed as a solution as well as a preventive effort against negative impacts that potentially harm the interests of the community.

The absence of a specific Regional Regulation governing Social Protection for Women and Children in Wonosobo Regency makes the urgency of this Regional Regulation indeed necessary as a legal umbrella for the creation of legal certainty in matters of Social Protection for Women and Children, which is an obligation of the Regional Government, specifically the Wonosobo Regional Government, to provide Social Protection for Women and Children of Wonosobo Regency.
